purpose: Comparisons inside the ACS class: graded variants of the TIPA mechanism that keep CR-2b.  est-k: the self-state reading used by the mechanism (MinACS energy / furnace temperature) is quantised to multiples of k (floor; a positive value is never read as 0).  upd-k: the internal model is updated only every k steps; upd-none: never.  The A/B1/C records of P10 are kept for each run.
tuning_history: Nothing tuned.  Variants written before any run; one smoke test: tuning seed 1 (cold_len 3, regrow 5, gifts 3): T_col base 11, est-2 11, est-3 11, upd-2 15, upd-4 15, upd-none 15.
cr2_note: check_cr2_variants.py: est-2 and est-3 satisfy CR-2b in both domains; upd-k changes only Update, which CR-2b does not involve.

hypotheses.statement: base の崩壊到達時刻は est-2 以上である（推定の分解能または更新の頻度が高い方が長く存続する）。
hypotheses.how_it_could_fail: 推定の粗さや更新の遅れが、行動の時機を偶然に有利にずらす場合がある（E7 の天候を見ない劣化では 172 単位で劣化の方が長く存続した）。登録前の試運転：tuning seed 1 (cold_len 3, regrow 5, gifts 3): T_col base 11, est-2 11, est-3 11, upd-2 15, upd-4 15, upd-none 15。
